# 迎接AI搜索的五项行动

- 作者：Flavio Amiel（@fba）
- 原帖发布时间：2026-05-20 16:54（北京时间）
- 原帖：https://x.com/fba/status/2057022116797493268
- 收藏日期：2026-10-29

## 中文全文

我看了 6 分钟 Google I/O 活动，很明显，我们熟悉的搜索正在消失。

AI 搜索才是未来。

一切都在变成聊天机器人。

那你该怎样为此布局？

看看这 5 项能让你领先一步的行动：

1) 打造你的品牌

LLM 不会给你排名，它们只是在重复互联网上其他人已经说过的关于你的信息。

例如，外链和／或品牌提及。

大家在夸你？你就会出现。

大家在批评你？也一样。

没人谈论你 = 模型没有任何关于你的话可以重复。

所以，检查你的评价，争取上播客，等等。

2) 制造共识

让自己与行业大玩家出现在相同的讨论场合里。

榜单文章、比较内容、Reddit 讨论串、播客。

模型会相信它更经常看到的东西。

3) 做出与众不同的东西

- 免费工具
- 一套框架
- 原创数据
- 别人没有的观点

你懂我的意思。

4) 靠 E-E-A-T 一步步往上走

就是大多数 SEO 从业者说没用的那些东西：
经验、专业性、权威性、可信度。

用真实的作者简介、真实资历、个人介绍等，为内容提供支撑。

这类东西，机构总是跳过，但我亲眼见过它们起作用。对于 YMYL 等特定类别，你还得加倍投入。

如果是一个发声者还不多的新领域，这种做法也非常有效。

5) 追踪这些事情到底有没有效果

人人都在‘做 AI SEO’，却没人衡量自己是否真的出现在答案里。

一个你连看都不愿看的数字，是无法改善的。

所以，今晚就去跑一些查询，看看谁被引用了，深入研究，再制定计划，做到与他们一样好，甚至更好。

就这些。

做到之后，你就能领先于其他人。

哦，等等，什么鬼！这些难道都不是新东西吗？？？

这就是 SEO！

还是同一套基本功 😅

区别在于，你需要比过去更重视其中某些部分。

以前靠玩 SEO 技巧就能获得流量，即使没做品牌建设，也没做好 E-E-A-T，仍然可以过关。

如果你以前是在花钱买外链，现在就得思考，怎样出现在顶级播客节目等渠道中。

这要求你在自己的领域里积累一定的专业知识。

以前把技术 SEO 做好，就能超越别人，从而获得更多流量。

现在有了 AI，这些变得容易了，所以你必须想出新的方法，把所有努力结合起来，持续做得更好。

搜索的未来充满机会。

趁还来得及，赶紧参与。

## 英文原文

I watched 6 minutes of the Google I/O event and it's clear search as we know it is going away.

AI search is the future.

Everything becomes a chatbot.

So how do you position for it? 

Check 5 moves to get ahead of the pack:

1) Work on your brand

LLMs don't rank you, they repeat what the rest of the internet already says about you.

(e.g. backlinks and/or brand mentions)

People talk good about you? You get up there.

People talking bad about you? Same.

No one talking about you = the model has nothing to repeat.

SO check your reviews, go into podcasts appearances, etc.

2) Fabricate consensus

Get mentioned in the same rooms as the big players.

Listicles, comparisons, Reddit threads, podcasts.

The model believes whatever it sees more often.

3) Build things that stand out

- Free tools
- A framework 
- Original data
- A take nobody else has

You get my drift.

4) E-E-A-T your way up the ladder

The thing most SEOs say don't work: 
Experience. Expertise. Authority. Trust. 

Support content with real author bios, real credentials, bios, etc.

This is the kind of stuff agencies always skip, but I've seen first hand working (and you've got to double down on specific categories like YMYL)

It also works great if it's a new category with not a lot of voices.

5) Track whether any of this works

Everyone's "doing AI SEO" but nobody's measuring if they show up in the answers.

You can't improve a number you refuse to look at.

So go run some queries tonight, check who gets cited, do a deep dive, and put a plan together to match their work or improve upon it.

That's it. 

You'll be ahead of the pack now.

Oh, but wait, what the heck! None of this is new???

This is SEO! 

Same fundamentals 😅

The difference is that you need to pay more attention to some things over the others.

By gaming SEO you used to get volume and you could get away without the branding, nor EEAT part. 

If you were paying for backlinks before, now you have to think how to show up in the top tier podcasts programs, etc.

That requires to build some expertise in your area.

With a good technical SEO you'd get to be better than others, hence getting more traffic too. 

Now with AI that's easy, so you have to think in novel ways to encompass all your efforts to be better, all the time.

The future of search is full of opportunities.

Get in before it's too late.
